Package daemon; imports the standard library, `morphstudio/internal/testhelp`, `morphstudio/claude`, `morphstudio/control`, `morphstudio/queue`, `morphstudio/registry`, `morphstudio/runner`, `morphstudio/session`, `morphstudio/stream`, `morphstudio/supervisor`, `morphstudio/telegram` and `morphstudio/eventlog` only; compare with `testhelp.Equal`. The harness of example 1 is one struct type `puHarness` of this file and every other helper is prefixed `pu` (another test file of package daemon declares its own `dc` helpers): reg, err := registry.Open(filepath.Join(tmp, "state")); reg.Add(registry.Project{...}) returns error; docs/MEASURE.md from os.ReadFile("../tests/fixtures/git/measure.md"); `&runner.Fake{Script: map[string]runner.Result{...}}`; Spawn func(ctx context.Context, l claude.Launch) (claude.Process, error) appending l and a new claude.NewFake() (*claude.Fake: Emit([]byte), Finish(int), Written() [][]byte) to two slices; Post func(ctx context.Context, project, kind, headline, numbers string) (telegram.Status, error) appending [4]string{project, kind, headline, numbers}; Now a clock from time.Date(2026, 10, 8, 15, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) advancing 1 s per call; NewID fmt.Sprintf("id-%d", n); Spawn, Post, Now and NewID guarded by one sync.Mutex and read back under it (the pump calls them from its goroutine); d, err := Open(context.Background(), deps); the plan from os.ReadFile("../tests/fixtures/plan/queue-3.json") and json.Unmarshal into queue.Plan. Probe lines: `_, msg := testhelp.ProbeLine(t, "../tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl", n)` (msg is the raw bytes, with spaces: compare log Msg with the json.Compact of them). Where an example says poll, loop with time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) up to 2 s (up to 5 s in example 8) and fail with the last value seen. Example 8 spawns a real process: the Spawn func records l and returns claude.Start(ctx, script, claude.Args(l), l.Dir, nil) where script is filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "claude.sh") written by os.WriteFile with 0o755 and the record's exact three-line sh text (the stderr lines are literals: "Error: Invalid session ID. Must be a valid UUID." and "second line"); a log file is read by os.ReadFile and split on "\n" (the trailing empty piece dropped), one line decoded into eventlog.Entry (import morphstudio/eventlog), its Msg compared as string(entry.Msg) against a raw string literal; LastExit as *s.LastExit against a control.Exit value after checking it is not nil and !At.IsZero() (zero At first); an expected nil LastExit by s.LastExit == nil. Arities: Status, Events, Order, Pending, Usage and PlanLoad return two values; Answer and Restart return error; Wait and Tick return nothing; stream.Allow returns ([]byte, error); stream.User returns []byte. Write every headline, numbers string and line as one whole string literal ("P17: weekly usage 60%", "success · turns 1 · $0.0022", "session id-1 · dirty tree (1 paths)", "restart 1 of 3 this hour · Error: Invalid session ID. Must be a valid UUID.", "exited 4 times within an hour (last code 1): Error: Invalid session ID. Must be a valid UUID.", "Continue by docs/AUTONOMY.md from where you stopped; the usage window has reset."). Examples 10 and 11 build the harness of example 1 with Config.DoneWait: 45 * time.Second (every other example leaves it 0), replay example 1's emits to the ready machine, then d.Order, d.PhaseDone (returns error) and the emit of line 31 or fp.Finish(0); poll the Launch recorder's length under the mutex; the state file is decoded into State (this package's) and Loop.StretchUSD compared as a float64 literal (0.005775230000000001, 0.0021784900000000004); d.Usage returns (control.Usage, error). Write the texts whole ("P17 turn ended: PICKED=Option B", "success · turns 2 · $0.0058", "session id-3 · cap $12 · 3 h"). Go 1.25, gofmt-formatted.

config-and-main-judge.instruction: Write ONLY the test file `cmd/morphd/config_examples_test.go`: one `func TestConfigAndMainExample<n>(t *testing.T)` per example of the Function Config And Main (files cmd/morphd/config.go and main.go) listed below, in example order. Do not write or modify any other file. Package main; imports the standard library, `morphstudio/internal/testhelp`, `morphstudio/control`, `morphstudio/queue`, `morphstudio/github` and `morphstudio/session` only; compare with `testhelp.Equal` (a whole Config literal; ExtraArgs nil when the record says nil). getenv is a func(string) string over a map literal. Arities: ParseDotenv returns one map; Load returns (Config, error), compare err.Error() with the whole text. Example 5: the fake Control is one struct type `cmFake` of this file implementing all 17 methods of control.Control with their exact signatures (from control/control.go; Order returns (session.OrderResult, error)); every other helper is prefixed `cm`; never a listener and main() is never called: Build returns an http.Handler served by h.ServeHTTP(httptest.NewRecorder(), req); compare rec.Code and rec.Body.String() against a Go raw string literal holding exactly the record's JSON, then + "\n"; decode the MCP body with encoding/json, count result.tools (11) and look for the tool names "status" and "events". The Config literal of examples 2 and 3 carries DoneWait (30; 45; then 0 from the dotenv); example 4's fourth error text is "config: MORPHD_DONE_WAIT: not a number: 1m". Examples 6 and 7 call UUIDv4([16]byte{0x96, 0x7e, ...}) and newID() of package main directly (no Build, no fake); the regexp by regexp.MustCompile on one whole raw string literal, the 36-character results compared whole. Write every path ("/healthz", "/projects/demo/status", "/mcp/demo"), Authorization value ("Bearer tok-7") and error text as its whole literal. Go 1.25, gofmt-formatted.

pm-tools-judge.instruction: Write ONLY the test file `mcpserver/pm_examples_test.go`: one `func TestPMToolsExample<n>(t *testing.T)` per example of `mcpserver/pm.go` listed below (the examples of the Function), in example order. Do not write or modify any other file. Package mcpserver; imports the standard library, `morphstudio/internal/testhelp`, `morphstudio/control`, `morphstudio/queue`, `morphstudio/github`, `morphstudio/session`, `morphstudio/eventlog` and `github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk/mcp` only; compare with `testhelp.Equal`. The fake Control is one struct type `ptFake` of this test file implementing all 17 methods of control.Control with their exact signatures (from control/control.go) PLUS `AdoptProject(ctx context.Context, name, dir, repoURL, language string) (control.ProjectView, error)` (so it is a control.Adopter), configurable results and errors, and a recorded call list (method and arguments); a second struct type `ptPlain` implements only the 17 methods (example 9's p); every other helper of this file is prefixed `pt` (other test files of package mcpserver declare their own fakes and helpers). Example 8's entries: `dir, msg := testhelp.ProbeLine(t, "../tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl", n)` then eventlog.Entry{Seq: int64(n), Dir: dir, Msg: msg} (import morphstudio/eventlog); its expected Text is one raw string literal holding exactly the record's JSON. The transport is mcp.NewInMemoryTransports(): ss, err := s.Connect(ctx, st, nil) on the server end and cs, err := mcp.NewClient(&mcp.Implementation{Name: "t", Version: "0"}, nil).Connect(ctx, ct, nil) on the other (both return two values), never HTTP; close with cs.Close() then ss.Wait(). Arities: cs.ListTools(ctx, nil) returns (*mcp.ListToolsResult, error) with .Tools []*mcp.Tool (.Name); cs.CallTool(ctx, &mcp.CallToolParams{Name: ..., Arguments: map[string]any{...}}) returns (*mcp.CallToolResult, error); a tool result reads res.IsError, res.StructuredContent and res.Content[0].(*mcp.TextContent).Text. Write every expected Text as one Go raw string literal (backticks) holding exactly the record's JSON, and every tool name, error text ("no_question: no pending question", "internal: disk full") and URL as its whole literal; plan_load's Arguments are os.ReadFile("../tests/fixtures/plan/queue-3.json") decoded with json.Unmarshal into map[string]any; example 4 uses PMServer(c, "beta"); example 7 sends {"option": "one"} and accepts a CallTool error or IsError true; example 9's call with only {"name": "studio"} likewise accepts a CallTool error or IsError true. Write the adopt error texts whole ("bad_input: bad input: bootstrap: refused: not a git repository: /home/morph/nowhere", "exists: project exists", "internal: adopt not supported"); a time is time.Date(2026, 10, 10, 18, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC). Times are time.Date(2026, 10, 8, h, m, s, 0, time.UTC). Go 1.25, gofmt-formatted.
